title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: insured value outside the product range at binding
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes what happens when the insured value fixed at binding falls outside the product's insured value range.

## Rule

1. The insured value fixed at binding, rounded to the cent, must lie within the product's minimum insured value and its maximum insured value of one cover, as the cover eligibility rules require.
2. A cover whose value so fixed is below the minimum or above the maximum is not bound at all.
3. No other value is substituted for it.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical range of 8,000.00 to 400,000.00 USD)

| Value fixed at binding | Judgement |
|---|---|
| 8,000.00 | Within the range; bound |
| 400,000.00 | Within the range; bound |
| 7,999.99 | Below the minimum; not bound, and not raised to 8,000.00 |
| 400,000.01 | Above the maximum; not bound, and not reduced to 400,000.00 |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- *Wrong reading:* bind at the maximum when the invoice value exceeds it. *Correct basis:* the cover is not bound at all; no other value is substituted.
